name: make_v5
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
s=open("source/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.roff",encoding="utf-8").read()
reps=[
("The audit's printed signature displays the same type using the standard notation for the natural numbers in place of Nat.",
 "The audit prints the same type, with standard natural-number notation in place of Nat."),
("The model checks are also stated exactly as in the source:",
 "The model checks are stated exactly as in the source:"),
("Thus there are n(n-1) horizontal tokens, two per transitive arc, plus n vertical tokens, for n*n tokens in all, and the outcome space has 2^(n*n) elements.",
 "Thus there are n(n-1) horizontal tokens, two per arc, plus n vertical tokens: n*n tokens and 2^(n*n) outcomes."),
("The counting bridge Bun.window_factor rewrites each full-outcome count as 2^(number of tokens outside the window) times the corresponding window-assignment count, so the two sides of the endpoint inequality share a common factor.",
 "The counting bridge Bun.window_factor rewrites each full-outcome count as 2^(tokens outside the window) times the corresponding window-assignment count, so both sides share a common factor."),
]
for a,b in reps:
    assert s.count(a)==1, a[:40]
    s=s.replace(a,b)
open("qa/tmp/v5.roff","w",encoding="utf-8").write(s)
print("ok")
